abilities.description:
Normal Attack
Proclaims a decree in the primordial tongue and performs up to 3 attacks that deal Pyro DMG.

Charged Attack
Consumes a certain amount of Stamina to deal AoE Pyro DMG to opponents in front of her after a short casting time.

Plunging Attack
Nicole plunges towards the ground from mid-air, damaging all opponents in her path. Also deals AoE Pyro DMG upon impact with the ground.

abilities.name: Revelation: Uncreated Light

_curatorNotes: Grace of Kenosis: flat ATK bonus to nearby party members = min(15% of Nicole's ATK, 600) at talent lvl 10 (skillBuffRatio[9]=0.15, skillBuffMax[9]=600). Computed once at cast from Nicole's ATK (gcsim skill.go c.skillBuff), fixed for 20s. Applies to the whole party including Nicole.
snapshottable=false pending confirmation: the recipient's ATK modifier is a live stat mod; unclear whether off-field DPS snapshot it. Flag-and-ask.

effects.caveat: Absorbs Pyro DMG at 250% effectiveness (absorption bonus vs Pyro not modelled).
_curatorNotes: Shield of Blazing Light scales on Nicole's ATK: 398.1% ATK + 3051 at talent lvl 10 (skillShieldAtk[9]=3.981312, skillShieldFlat[9]=3050.9045). gcsim shield.go, Expires = F + 20*60.
Base shield (target 'active', per gcsim shield Target:-1) protects the on-field character. C2 extends a Shield of Blazing Light to nearby party members (separate effect on the C2 entry).

abilities.description:
Recreates a fleeting glimpse of an age long past, when the angels acted on the authority of the heavens, bestowing the **Grace of Kenosis** effect on nearby party members. This increases their ATK and deals AoE Pyro DMG, as well as creates a Shield of Blazing Light.
The Shield of Blazing Light's DMG Absorption is based on Nicole's ATK, and it will absorb Pyro DMG at 250% effectiveness.

abilities.name: Revelation: Ladder of Divine Ascent

effects.caveat: During Silent Contemplation (20s), when a nearby active party member hits an opponent, a coordinated Arcane Projection deals AoE Elemental DMG of that character's Element at 180% of their ATK, counted as their damage. Occurs once every 3s, up to 4 times per burst.
_curatorNotes: gcsim burst.go: burstKey status 20*60; projection deals burstProjection[9]=1.8 (180%) of the TRIGGERING character's ATK, element = char.Base.Element; burstICDKey=3*60; c.projections capped at 4 per burst. Projection lands projectionHitmark=30f after the triggering hit.

scaling stat 'atk' is a stand-in for the triggering character's ATK (the planner scales on the holder's stat). Element varies by triggering character, so element field is omitted. The 4-projection-per-burst cap is not modeled — timeline shows ticks bounded only by the 20s window and 3s ICD.
Nicole's own initial burst hit (570.2% ATK Pyro at T10, burstInitial[9]=5.7024) is on-field self damage, not a team-facing capability — not authored as an effect.

abilities.caveat: Not modeled: with 2 or more Hexerei characters in the party, Arcane Projections triggered by Hexerei members deal extra DMG equal to 300% of the caster's ATK.
_curatorNotes: HEXEREI Secret Rite (count-gated). gcsim asc.go:111-123 hexereiOnProjection: requires Nicole IsHexerei AND GetHexereiCount() >= 2 AND the triggering character IsHexerei; returns c.TotalAtk()*3, applied as AttackInfo.FlatDmg on the burst projection (burst.go:164) and on C1's Arcane Projection: Unity (cons.go:56).

Pure damage-magnitude enhancement to an existing hit (flat add, no new instance, no stat change) — recorded, not authored as an effect. Lives in factionBonuses as a description-only Secret Rite entry plus this caveat.
abilities.description:
As Nicole weaves the path of anchored fate with golden threads of light, she deals AoE Pyro DMG and switches to Silent Contemplation mode.
In this mode, when nearby active party members hit an opponent, an Arcane Projection is summoned to perform a Coordinated Attack against the opponent, dealing AoE Elemental DMG of the character's corresponding Elemental Type. This DMG scales based on the corresponding character's ATK and will be considered as having been dealt by them.
This effect can occur once every 3s, and can be triggered up to 4 times each time Nicole switches to Silent Contemplation mode.

It is worth noting that Hexerei characters' Arcane Projections appear to differ somehow in appearance from the others...

passives.name: Methexis

effects.caveat: Grace of Kenosis upgrades to Guidance of Theosis (+300 ATK) after the observed character stays on-field for 3s — instantly for Hexerei characters. Reverts to Grace of Kenosis when they leave the field (no longer reverts at C6).
_curatorNotes: A1 Methexis: gcsim asc.go a1Buff[ATK]=300, upgrade delay 3*60 (0 for Hexerei). Upgrade duration bounded by the remaining Grace of Kenosis window (<=20s); modeled as 20s fixed with the 3s-observe caveat.

HEXEREI permanent patch (NOT count-gated): gcsim asc.go:35-38 sets delay=0 on a bare `char.IsHexerei` check with no GetHexereiCount() gate — a Hexerei observed character gets Guidance of Theosis immediately, even as the only other Hexerei member. Value (+300 ATK) unchanged; only the 3s observation delay is skipped. Already surfaced in this effect's caveat.

passives.description:
For 20s after unleashing the Elemental Skill **Revelation: Uncreated Light**, Nicole will continuously "observe" the other current active party members. After the observed character has remained on the field for 3s, their **Grace of Kenosis** is upgraded to **Guidance of Theosis**, increasing their ATK by an additional 300. If the observed character is a Hexerei character, Grace of Kenosis is upgraded to Guidance of Theosis straight away.
When characters other than Nicole who have Guidance of Theosis leave the field, their effect reverts to Grace of Kenosis.

passives.name: Philokalia

effects.caveat: Nicole's own Grace of Kenosis upgrades to Guidance of Theosis (+300 ATK) for 8s whenever a nearby active party member's Elemental DMG hits an opponent.
_curatorNotes: A4 Philokalia: gcsim asc.go a4Init upgrades Nicole's own buff on active-member elemental hit for c6SelfBuffDur = 8s (C0). Self-only; boosts Nicole's ATK (marginally her shield/Grace scaling on subsequent casts). At C6 the self-upgrade duration is -1 (matches remaining Grace window).

passives.description: When Elemental DMG from nearby active party members hits an opponent, Nicole's own **Grace of Kenosis** effect is upgraded to **Guidance of Theosis** for 8s.

constellations.name: "Do Not Be Afraid, Child Who Is Loved"

effects.caveat: When your active character hits an opponent, an extra Arcane Projection deals AoE Elemental DMG of that character's Element at 600% of their ATK, counted as their damage. Once every 6s.
_curatorNotes: gcsim cons.go c1Init: OnEnemyHit by active char, c1ICDKey=6*60, Mult:6 (600%) of the triggering character's ATK, element = char.Base.Element, lands projectionHitmark=30f later. Independent of the burst — fires whenever the active char hits, not gated on Silent Contemplation.

scaling stat 'atk' is a stand-in for the triggering character's ATK; element omitted (varies). This damage effect does not itself derive an offFieldDamage capability (that comes from the burst coordinatedAttack tag at C0).

HEXEREI Secret Rite also applies here: cons.go:56 passes FlatDmg = hexereiOnProjection(char), so with 2+ Hexerei in the party a Unity projection triggered by a Hexerei member gains flat DMG equal to 300% of Nicole's ATK. Damage-magnitude only — not authored as an effect; the canonical player-facing note sits on the burst.

constellations.description:
When the current active character of your own in the party hits an opponent, an additional special "Arcane Projection: Unity" will be summoned to perform a Coordinated Attack against the opponent, dealing AoE Elemental DMG of the character's corresponding Elemental Type at 600% of their ATK. This DMG will be considered as having been dealt by the corresponding character.
This effect can trigger once every 6s.

constellations.name: "I Will Guide You and Show You the Path You Should Tread"

_curatorNotes: C2 adds +300 flat ATK to Grace of Kenosis for all nearby party members (does not count toward the base ATK Bonus limit). gcsim cons.go c2Buff[ATK]=300, added to all chars on skill cast for skillDur (20s).

effects.caveat: While the active character has Guidance of Theosis, nearby opponents' RES to that character's Element is reduced by 25%. Does not stack for the same Element.
_curatorNotes: gcsim cons.go c2Ticker: -0.25 RES to the active char's element, re-applied every 0.3s (1s modifier) while they hold Guidance of Theosis (a1Key). Element varies by active character, so element field is omitted (derives as 'all'). Uptime follows Guidance (up to the 20s skill-buff window); modeled as 20s refresh.

C2: nearby active party members also gain a Shield of Blazing Light on skill cast (same scaling as base: 398.1% Nicole ATK + 3051). Extends the base shield beyond the active character to the whole party.

constellations.description:
Enhances the effects of the Elemental Skill **Revelation: Uncreated Light**: **Grace of Kenosis** increases ATK by an additional 300 (which does not count toward this effect's ATK Bonus limit), while **Guidance of Theosis** decreases nearby opponents' Elemental RES based on the corresponding character's Elemental Type by 25%. This effect does not stack for the same Element.
Additionally, when Nicole unleashes her Elemental Skill Revelation: Uncreated Light, nearby active party members will also gain a Shield of Blazing Light.

constellations.name: "A Lamp by Your Side, A Light to Shine the Way"
constellations.description:
Increases the Level of **Revelation: Uncreated Light** by 3.
Maximum upgrade level is 15.

constellations.name: "Whether Left or Right, No Matter Which Way You Turn"

_curatorNotes: [A7b] AUTHORED 2026-07-20 (implement-first): Pathfinder's Blessing as an active-target normalFlatDmg buff scaling 70% of the caster's ATK (gcsim cons.go c4Init: FlatDmg += 0.7*Nicole.TotalAtk), onCast skill / 20s fixed, mirroring the sibling C2 (+300 flat ATK) and C6 shapes which model the Guidance window optimistically. Single-class authoring (normalFlatDmg only) per the Escoffier C2 legibility precedent — in game the add covers N/CA/Plunge/E/Q from one shared pool.

constellations.caveat: Not modeled: it drops after 8 hits (one instance per opponent struck), so the shown window may run longer than the real one.
_curatorNotes: C4 Pathfinder's Blessing: when a party member's Grace of Kenosis upgrades to Guidance of Theosis, they gain Pathfinder's Blessing for 20s (once per 16s per character). Their N/CA/Plunge/E/Q DMG is increased by 70% of Nicole's ATK as flat DMG; removed after 8 instances or when the duration ends (instances consumed = number of opponents hit). gcsim cons.go c4Init: FlatDmg += 0.7*Nicole.TotalAtk, Tags[c4Key]=8, c4Key 20*60, c4ICDKey 16*60.

[A7b] The former flag-and-ask (per-class *FlatDmg approximation) was RESOLVED 2026-07-20 by authoring normalFlatDmg only (Escoffier legibility precedent). Residual un-modeled: the shared 8-instance consumable pool and the 16s-per-character re-trigger gate — surfaced in the caveat.
constellations.description:
When nearby party members have their **Grace of Kenosis** upgraded to **Guidance of Theosis**, Nicole also bestows upon them the Pathfinder's Blessing effect for 20s. Each character can gain this effect once every 16s.
The Normal Attack, Charged Attack, Plunging Attack, Elemental Skill, and Elemental Burst DMG of characters with Pathfinder's Blessing is increased by 70% of Nicole's ATK. This effect will be removed once it has taken effect 8 times or when its duration is over.
When multiple opponents are hit at once, instances of Pathfinder's Blessing are consumed equal to the number of opponents hit. Each character's Pathfinder's Blessing is counted independently.

Increases the Level of **Revelation: Ladder of Divine Ascent** by 3.
Maximum upgrade level is 15.

constellations.name: "This Is the Path, Walk It Without Delay"

effects.caveat: Party members holding Guidance of Theosis ignore 40% of the enemy's DEF — at C6 the whole team holds it.

_curatorNotes: C6: when Nicole's Grace of Kenosis upgrades to Guidance of Theosis, all nearby party members' Grace of Kenosis also upgrades, and Guidance of Theosis no longer reverts to Grace of Kenosis (permanent uptime within the window). gcsim cons.go c6OnUpgrade + c6DeleteA1OnSwap (no swap-revert at C6), c6SelfBuffDur returns -1.

DEF ignore authored 2026-07-14 via the defIgnore Stat (G7): DMG dealt by Guidance-of-Theosis holders ignores 40% of opponents' DEF (gcsim c6Init: IgnoreDefPercent += 0.4). Modeled target:team (whole party holds Guidance at C6), 20s to match the skill's Grace window.
constellations.description:
When Nicole's **Grace of Kenosis** is upgraded to **Guidance of Theosis**, all nearby party members' Grace of Kenosis will also be upgraded to Guidance of Theosis. Once upgraded, Guidance of Theosis will no longer revert to Grace of Kenosis.
Additionally, DMG dealt by characters with Guidance of Theosis will ignore 40% of opponents' DEF.

factionBonuses.name: Secret Rite
factionBonuses.description: When 2+ Hexerei members are in the team, Arcane Projections triggered by Hexerei members deal additional DMG equal to 300% of Nicole's ATK. Applies to the burst's Arcane Projections and, at C1, to Arcane Projection: Unity. No stat buff, heal, shred, or energy is granted, so nothing is authored as an effect — the rite is a damage-magnitude enhancement only, surfaced as a caveat on the burst.
